## Overview

This manual provides the practical guide and problem set for **Lab 4: File I/O and Serialization**,
conducted as part of the Advanced Programming course (Spring Semester 2024) at Amirkabir University of Technology. 

Delivered as an online session on 13 March 2024,
the workshop was designed to give students hands-on experience with Java's stream architectures,
file input/output operations, and object serialization.
Students had to work through guided programming exercises and submit their completed solutions for assessment.
